# Edmund Carrow & John Ashdown

- [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) — Friend of — [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) — close companions who converse without restraint · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During a church service, [Grace](../character/grace.md) interrupts the collection to publicly defend her father and clarify the misunderstanding behind their Sunday cleaning. The next day, she and Edmund ride pigs down Main Street, drawing mixed reactions from townspeople and the local doctor's family. Later, Miss Winifred visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to complain about Grace's antics, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends the child's brave intentions.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) encounters [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) by the hidden spring in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and crafts a birch cup for her to drink from. He walks her home while engaging in warm conversation, and she invites him into her house, where her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) joins them in discussing global affairs.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

> Edmund finishes his fight with [Dan Coyle](../character/coyle.md), forcing Dan to retract his insults. On his way home through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), Edmund encounters Mr. Ashdown, who praises him for defending the honor of women. Later, after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tends to Edmund's bruises, Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss the fight as well as rumors regarding Mr. Ashdown courting [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).
>
